**ID:** X0361
**Volume:** X20

**Byline:** 宋 宗曉述

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X361 is [宗曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%9B%89)'s two-fascicle Southern-Sòng *zhàojiě* 照解 ("illuminating explanation") of the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa*, divided into ten sections of which the ninth contains the celebrated cycle of thirty-six question-and-answer (三十六問答) — a catechetical schema designed for liturgical-pedagogical use rather than for technical doctrinal exposition.

**Abstract**

The work is one of three major contributions [宗曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%9B%89) made to the late-Sòng Tiāntái scholastic establishment, alongside the *[Sìmíng zūnzhě jiàoxíng lù 四明尊者教行錄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186)* (T1937) and the *Lèbāng wénlèi* 樂邦文類 (T1969A). X361 is more catechetical than the conventional Tiāntái commentaries of [T1784](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305) / [T1786](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307) and was apparently aimed at a less specialist audience; the thirty-six question-and-answer format suggests use in lecture or oral examination. Date bracket follows [宗曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%9B%89)'s mature productive period at Sìmíng (1180–1214). The transmission to Japan and the 1695 reprint are testimony to the influence the work continued to exercise on Tendai scholasticism into the Edo period.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301) (金光明經 / T663).
